stem: $ABCD$ is a cyclic quadrilateral. The side $CD$ is produced to $E$. If $m(\angle ADE) = (2x + {=p})^\circ$ and $m(\angle ABC) = (x + {=q})^\circ$, find $m(\angle ABC)$ in degrees.
solution: $\angle ADE$ is the exterior angle at $D$, so it equals the interior angle at the opposite vertex $B$.
notes: x = q - p. No parent book question available.
